title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
summary: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
body: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
summaryZh: OpenAI与东南亚超级应用Grab宣布合作推出“GO Forward with AI”区域计划，旨在帮助东南亚地区的30,000名合作伙伴及中小企业构建实用的AI应用技能，进一步推动大模型技术在现实商业生态中的普及与真实采用。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与Grab联合推出面向东南亚的AI技能提升项目，推动大模型在真实商业场景中的落地普及。

glossary.explanationZh: 企业和组织在实际业务中应用人工智能技术的进程
